"""Extra validation-boundary tests (inclusive comparisons, large values)."""
import json
import sys

sys.path.insert(0, '/workspace/submission')
from crosscheck.engine import run_request

failures = []


def check(name, got, expected):
    if got != expected:
        failures.append(name)
        print('FAIL', name, 'got', json.dumps(got),
              'expected', json.dumps(expected))
    else:
        print('ok  ', name)


TOPO = {
    'nodes': [{'id': 0, 'name': 'A', 'external_capacity': 100},
              {'id': 1, 'name': 'B', 'external_capacity': 100}],
    'links': [{'source': 0, 'target': 1, 'capacity': 100}],
    'external_nodes': ['A', 'B'],
}
PATHS = {'A': {'B': [{'path': ['A', 'B'], 'weight': 1000}]},
         'B': {'A': [{'path': ['B', 'A'], 'weight': 1000}]}}
COUNTERS = {
    'low_A_egress_to_B': {'perturbed': 10},
    'low_B_ingress_from_A': {'perturbed': 10},
    'low_B_egress_to_A': {'perturbed': 3},
    'low_A_ingress_from_B': {'perturbed': 3},
    'low_A_origination': {'perturbed': 10},
    'low_A_termination': {'perturbed': 3},
    'low_B_origination': {'perturbed': 3},
    'low_B_termination': {'perturbed': 10},
}
EVENTS = [
    {'op': 'patch', 'demands': [[0, 1, 10], [1, 0, 3]], 'counters': COUNTERS},
    {'op': 'routes', 'label': 'p', 'paths': PATHS},
    {'op': 'repair', 'id': 'x'},
    {'op': 'validate', 'id': 'x'},
]


def run(settings, events=EVENTS, topo=TOPO):
    return run_request({'streams': [{'topology': topo, 'settings': settings,
                                     'events': events}]})['streams'][0]['events']


BASE = {'trials': 2, 'epsilon': 0, 'seed': 7, 'cutoff': [0, 1],
        'bias': 0, 'tau': 0, 'gamma': [1, 1], 'cache_slots': 2}

# cutoff exactly equal to a published confidence (external = 3, internal = 5)
s = dict(BASE)
s['cutoff'] = [3, 1]
out = run(s)
check('cutoff equal includes', out[3]['checked'], 8)
s['cutoff'] = [3, 1, 1]  # 3/1 unreduced form
out = run(s)
check('cutoff unreduced equal', out[3]['checked'], 8)
s['cutoff'] = [16, 5]  # 3.2 > 3 excludes external
out = run(s)
check('cutoff just above', out[3]['checked'], 4)
s['cutoff'] = [5, 1]
out = run(s)
check('cutoff at max confidence', out[3]['checked'], 4)
s['cutoff'] = [0, 7]
out = run(s)
check('cutoff zero', out[3]['checked'], 8)

# gamma exactly at the ratio: 6/8 == 3/4
s = dict(BASE)
s['tau'] = 1
s['gamma'] = [3, 4]
out = run(s)
check('gamma exact', out[3]['consistent'],
      out[3]['passed'] * 4 == out[3]['checked'] * 3)
# make a deterministic partial pass: shift one counter
events = list(EVENTS)
events[0] = {'op': 'patch', 'demands': [[0, 1, 10], [1, 0, 3]],
             'counters': dict(COUNTERS, low_A_origination={'perturbed': 12})}
s = dict(BASE)
s['gamma'] = [7, 8]
out = run(s, events)
check('gamma gate false', out[3]['consistent'], False)
s['gamma'] = [1, 8]
out = run(s, events)
check('gamma gate true', out[3]['consistent'], True)

# tau inclusive boundary: corrected 10 vs predicted 11 -> |X-Y| = 1e6,
# max = 11e6 -> tau = 90909 gives 1e6 <= 0.90909e7? no; 90910 passes
events = list(EVENTS)
events[0] = {'op': 'patch', 'demands': [[0, 1, 11], [1, 0, 3]],
             'counters': dict(COUNTERS, low_A_egress_to_B={'perturbed': 10},
                              low_B_ingress_from_A={'perturbed': 10})}
s = dict(BASE)
s['tau'] = 90909
out = run(s, events)
check('tau just below', out[3]['passed'], 8)
s['tau'] = 90910
out = run(s, events)
check('tau just above', out[3]['passed'], 6)

# large magnitudes
big = {
    'nodes': [{'id': 0, 'name': 'A', 'external_capacity': 1000000000},
              {'id': 1, 'name': 'B', 'external_capacity': 1000000000}],
    'links': [{'source': 0, 'target': 1, 'capacity': 1000000000}],
    'external_nodes': ['A', 'B'],
}
events = [
    {'op': 'patch', 'demands': [[0, 1, 1000000000], [1, 0, 999999999]],
     'counters': {'low_A_egress_to_B': {'perturbed': 1000000000},
                  'low_B_ingress_from_A': {'perturbed': 1000000000}}},
    {'op': 'routes', 'label': 'p', 'paths': PATHS},
    {'op': 'repair', 'id': 'big'},
    {'op': 'validate', 'id': 'big'},
]
s = dict(BASE)
s['trials'] = 5
s['epsilon'] = 250000
out = run(s, events, big)
check('large values validate', (out[3]['checked'], out[3]['passed']), (8, 8))
check('large values repaired', out[2]['links'][3][2], 1000000000)

print()
print('FAILURES:', failures if failures else 'none')
PYEOF
